run_average_checkpoints_cli: run the CLI tool to average multiple PyTorch checkpoint files into a single averaged checkpoint
run_average_last_n_epoch_checkpoints: run the CLI tool to average the last N epoch-based checkpoints from a directory
run_average_last_n_update_checkpoints: run the CLI tool to average the last N update-based checkpoints from a directory
review_average_checkpoints_function: review the average_checkpoints function that loads and averages model weights from multiple checkpoint files
review_last_n_checkpoints_function: review the last_n_checkpoints function that discovers and selects the last N checkpoint files by name pattern
